scope: Driver-only amendment for future original-cube certificates; base encoders, mathematical bridge, cube predicates and all old certificates unchanged
new_transport_details: Create normal proof FIFO with nonblocking parent read and keepalive-write endpoints; switch read descriptor to blocking before passing it to checker stdin -i. Native solvers use the normal FIFO pathname proven by earlier runs, not /dev/fd.

Start checker and writer without blocking parent FIFO opens. Parent keeps read endpoint open and closes keepalive writer when native solver exits, delivering EOF even after a premature writer exit. An early checker exit cooperatively terminates the writer. Both children are reaped with bounded SIGTERM waits; never SIGKILL.
Write complete solver/checker logs directly to exclusive files, avoiding output-pipe backpressure. Preserve SAT models. Accept only solver rc20, checker rc0, exactly s VERIFIED, and no safety stop.
Resolve and hash the actual native solver executable before spawning, record its absolute path and checker/source hashes.
Sample aggregate RSS every0.25s, abort above3.5GiB or below12e9 free bytes; persist append-only timestamped pipeline checkpoints every15min and at completion.

Native solver and checker limits each3600s, combined wall guard7320s, within3h per certificate. This increases solver time from the unused first cube driver1800s to accommodate proof-generation overhead on C321/C411 screens taking1373.284/1755.924s.
